title: Build a sourced linear-equations lesson and dynamic practice family

audience.curriculum: England; illustrative secondary maths, not a confirmed school assignment
audience.level: KS3 starting example; actual school year must be configured

objectives.description: Solve a*x+b=c in the declared positive-integer coefficient domain, explain balanced operations, and verify by substitution.

contentRequirements: Explain equality and inverse operations with cited worked examples and a text alternative to a balance diagram.
Explain applying an operation to only one side; distinguish assisted from independent success.
Supply English and Spanish explanations with identical mathematics; assessed language stays configurable.
One mark for a supported rational satisfying the equation; do not infer method credit from an answer alone.

generation.parameterDomain: Integers a in 1..9, b in 0..20, s in 0..12; c=a*s+b.
generation.algorithm: Sample (a,b,s) deterministically from the explicit seed and approved constraints, calculate c exactly, and freeze the instance.
constraints: a must be nonzero; all values stay within the declared domain.
Negative coefficients and fractional solutions are unavailable in this family.
Return unavailable if constraints cannot be met within maxGenerationAttempts.
difficultyDimensions: Coefficient one versus greater than one

assessment.responseContract: JSON string containing a scalar integer, finite decimal, or fraction of integers; surrounding whitespace allowed. No arbitrary expressions or variables. Declare locale handling in the response grammar.
assessment.checkerStrategy: Parse an exact rational and independently check a*answer+b=c; do not just compare to the generator answer string.
rules: One criterion: solution-value, maximum one mark.
Equivalent rationals are accepted if the prompt imposes no answer-form restriction.
A valid nonsatisfying answer is incorrect.
Invalid input, zero denominators, unsupported syntax and checker failure are unassessed with reasons.
Do not infer method credit, broad transfer or mastery from final-answer success.
The host tracks hints and solution reveals separately from correctness.

cases.reason: x=0 is valid in this family.
The grammar does not include symbolic functions; request a supported form.

interactionRequirements: Balance diagram and prompt use the same public equation state, with a keyboard/text alternative.
Learn mode supports declared balanced subtract/divide actions and reset; preserve exact state and use text if a scene cannot represent it faithfully.
Mock-exam mode withholds solving controls, private solution data and live checking.
Voice uses the same state and semantic controls; confirm ambiguous spoken answers before assessment.
families.transferRequirement: After explanation, test an unseen symbolic instance. Tag the family; broader word-problem transfer requires a separately validated family and is not established by this module.

requirements.statement: Explanations resolve to the supplied sources.
requirements.verification: Verify digests, anchors, sourceRef closure and semantic support.

requirements.statement: Fresh questions are valid, reproducible and need no model request at study time.
requirements.verification: Exhaust all 2457 parameter tuples and test fixed-seed repeats and infeasible constraints.

requirements.statement: Answer correctness and uncertainty match the contract.
requirements.verification: Run supplied cases and independent checker fixtures covering each applicable outcome.

requirements.statement: Diagram, prompt and checker agree; exam mode does not leak answers.
requirements.verification: Validate scene data and inspect rendered captures when a compatible renderer exists.

requirements.statement: Learn, attempt independently, receive feedback and revisit the objective.
requirements.verification: Run the student journey in the host when available; otherwise report that check pending.

requirements.statement: Both packages obey the v1 manifest, dependency and runtime contracts.
requirements.verification: Validate inventories, hashes, local schemas, named exports and available host import checks.

nonGoals: Unrestricted network or filesystem access from modules
deliveryRequirements: Content and dynamic packages with exact source and dependency bindings
Bundled runtime, TypeScript source and reproducible build metadata
Manifest-bound reports with evidence or pending status for every requirement
No learner records, provider credentials, undeclared dependencies or install scripts
